resources.string: Type a message below. Use / for commands and @ for context.
Create a session to get started.
Make sure opencode serve is running and the app is connected to the server.
No usage yet — send a message to see token and cost figures.
Adopt server model/agent when guard drift is detected
Requests %1$d · errors %2$d · avg %3$.0f ms · max %4$.0f ms
Choose whether OpenCode follows the system, light, or dark theme
Customise the font used in code blocks
Customise the font used throughout the interface
Display model reasoning summaries in the timeline
Permission requests will be automatically approved
Play sound when a permission is required
Play sound when an error occurs
Play sound when the agent is complete or needs attention
Show edit, write, and patch tool parts expanded by default in the timeline
Show shell tool parts expanded by default in the timeline
Notify while the app is in the background: step progress and the finished answer (tap opens that session at that message)
Show system notification when a permission is required
Show system notification when an error occurs
Show the file tree panel in sessions
Show the search and command palette button in the title bar
Show the server status button in the title bar
Switch between agents in the composer. When hidden, defaults to Build agent.
Export writes your settings to a JSON file; Import applies one. Useful when moving to a new device.
Choose an opencode serve server or add a new URL.
Could not load the context usage: %1$s
Could not change the MCP server: %1$s
Could not load the todo list: %1$s
Secure storage unavailable — saved passwords may be lost: %1$s
Customize which models appear in the model selector.
Sign-in and switching happen on the start screen.
Last session status and a new-session shortcut
Shared content added to the prompt
Could not load the pending questions: %1$s
Could not answer the permission request: %1$s
This resets ALL app settings to their defaults (appearance, notifications, sounds, server settings and the guard token). This cannot be undone.
Only sessions with a session guard
Discard this message and everything after it? The server keeps the data, but the conversation continues from this point.
Remove “%1$s” from the project list? Sessions on the server are kept.
Remove %1$s from this device? The saved credentials are deleted; the server itself is not changed.
Could not adopt the server selection: %1$s
Could not remove the guard selection: %1$s
Some saved data could not be loaded (%1$s). Settings or servers may be missing until the app is restarted.
On the server, not in your list
The agent needs an answer to continue
No text diff available for this file (binary or renamed)
Forked — the new session id could not be read; pull to refresh the list
The shared image could not be taken over
No app can open this link
The turn ended with an error
Attachments cannot be queued — send the message directly
Show the model\'s thinking (reasoning) expanded by default in the timeline. Needs "Show reasoning summaries" for thinking to appear at all.
Hide the guard\'s status row and actions in the chat. The guard keeps working — only the chrome disappears.
No Session Guard detected right now — the switch has no effect until one is running
What the queue button does while a turn is running: queue the message or steer the running turn (send without interrupting)
Compact collapses tool and thinking blocks by default; advanced expands them. The individual switches below stay available.
Wrap long lines in diffs and code instead of scrolling horizontally
Master switch for every system notification and sound this app posts
Skills, MCP servers and plugins are managed under Extensions.
Pick a skill to inject it into this session — the agent starts on it right away.
The same prompt runs in its own session for every picked model — each one is a full turn on your key. Pick 2–3.
Type a prompt first — it becomes the race task
That model is not in the catalog
No connection — saved to the outbox (%1$d waiting)
%1$d waiting — sent automatically once the server is reachable
Nothing to import — the server has no older prompts here
A decision to remember for this project — kept locally and, on demand, handed to the agent.
Handing a decision over starts a turn with your current model (it costs tokens and the agent may act on it).
Could not hand the decision over
Widget, ongoing notification and tile show live step/progress, waiting decisions and today\'s cost
Watch sessions and notify while the app is not in focus. Off = nothing runs in the background
Foreground service keeps the stream up while the app is open (Android caps this at ~6 h/day)
Side questions about a message, diff or output run in their own session (spends tokens)
Allows injecting a captured decision into a session (starts a turn on your model)
Run one prompt against 2–3 models in parallel sessions (each is a full turn)
Waiting prompts are delivered as soon as the server is reachable; off = only via "Send now"
Limit: %1$d changed lines. Current: %2$d changed lines.
Show the unchanged lines around a change in a diff. Off keeps only the added and removed lines — quicker to read on a phone, and it applies to the chat and the Changes tab.
Interrupt every running turn? The agents keep the work already done; the turns end.
No events yet. Stopping turns, approvals and reverts show up here.
… %1$d more (all of them are in the copy)

Keep a local list of the actions that change state or spend money — stopping turns, approving or denying, reverting, forking, handing a decision over, MCP toggles. Shown in the Centre and copyable as Markdown. Off = nothing is recorded.
Capturing a decision injects it into the open session right away (starts a turn on your model). Off: it stays pending until you hand it over, and the journal row says so.
This session no longer exists on the server — it was probably deleted or cleaned up. Close it and pick another session.
The “context nearly full” insight gets a Compact button that asks the server to summarise the session. Off: the insight still appears, without the action. Compacting changes what the agent remembers.
“%1$s” will be permanently deleted from the server. This cannot be undone.
Send „Continue“, a slash command or a short instruction to a session straight from the Centre — no need to open it first. While a turn is running the prompt is queued, never interrupting it.
